service_os:
NAME="SLES"
VERSION="12-SP5"
VERSION_ID="12.5"
PRETTY_NAME="SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 12 SP5"
ID="sles"
ANSI_COLOR="0;32"
CPE_NAME="cpe:/o:suse:sles:12:sp5"

unit_checks.text:
# Disposable equivalent-v228 fixture; not a SLES production unit.
[Unit]
Description=File mover lifecycle qualification

[Service]
# v228 rate-limit directives belong in Service and use the old spelling.
StartLimitInterval=10
StartLimitBurst=2
Type=simple
User=mover
Group=mover
RootDirectory=/sles
EnvironmentFile=/run/fm-228.env
SyslogIdentifier=fm-228-legacy-candidate.service
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -eu -c 'true'
ExecStart=/tmp/release /tmp/fixture-config.json
# A failed contender can reach ExecStop in v228. Never run the global --stop
# controller here: it could stop an owner belonging to another unit/manual start.
# Default SIGTERM/control-group targets only this unit's processes.
KillMode=control-group
SendSIGKILL=no
TimeoutStopSec=75
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
CapabilityBoundingSet=
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077
PrivateTmp=no
unit_checks.stderr:
Cannot determine cgroup we are running in: Exec format error
Failed to initialize manager: Exec format error
